title: Biocircuits Explorer Result Artifact
description: Self-describing envelope (bne-result/v1) for a computed result. Generated/maintained alongside webapp/src/result_artifact.jl; attached additively as a sibling `artifact` field on responses, or as the top-level shape when a result is fully wrapped.

artifact_schema_version.description: Family/version of this envelope; the family prefix forks on incompatible changes.

kind.description: What produced this result, e.g. build_model, build_atlas, query_atlas, run_inverse_design.

input_hashes.description: Content hashes of the inputs this result was derived from (links a result to the exact IR/spec).

network_ir_hash.description: SHA-256 of the source NetworkIR (single-network results).

network_ir_hashes.description: SHA-256 of each source NetworkIR (multi-network specs).

design_spec_hash.description: SHA-256 of the source DesignSpec, when applicable.

version.description: App/algorithm version; bump when output semantics change.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonicalized config/spec; null when no config was supplied. Two runs with the same config_hash and input_hashes are reproducible.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues surfaced while producing the result.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the artifact was produced.

result.description: The payload, present only when the envelope fully wraps it (wrap_artifact); absent when the envelope is attached as a sibling `artifact` field on an otherwise-flat response.
